code:
Sharing rule: grants the support team
              read/write on ALL accounts

Problem: a few accounts are too
         sensitive for most of the team

Sharing rules can't subtract.
Restriction rules can.
caption: Restriction rules filter what a user already has down to criteria.

Rep has access to 3,000 accounts
but doesn't want them all in
default list views and lookups

Scoping rule: default = "my territory"
Underlying access: UNCHANGED
(rep can still search/open the rest)
caption: Scoping rules narrow the default VIEW, not real access.
